thread:
sara: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a 10% sample rollout for legacy credit exemptions (not full grandfathering) to validate edge-case billing logic. Need ops + billing sign-off before we hit 100% :eyes:
rahul: Can you paste the cohort definition and the sheet? want to double-check which SKUs are included.
sara: sheet -> https://ourcompany.sheets/ops/legacy-credit-sample (read-only). cohort = accounts with invoice_date <= 2023-12-31 AND plan != enterprise-legacy-exempt. excludes committed reserved customers. sampling tag = legacy_exempt_sample_v1 (10%).
mike: Quick note: when we apply exemptions we must ensure invoices already posted are not reissued automatically. we should create a credit memo flow for historic invoices. otherwise accounting reconciliation will explode.
sara: agreed. plan is: 1) apply exemption prospectively on new invoices 2) for any post-cutover historical credits, generate manual credit memos if balance > $5 3) auto-suppress reissue for invoices older than 30 days.
jen: how will A/B be split? we need a control (no exemption) and test (exemption). keep 1:1 randomization by account id. also add a flag in metering events: billing.legacy_exempt=true so reports can join.
rahul: regen logic for metering events sounds good. can we also log the decision reason? e.g., billing.legacy_exempt_reason=sample-rollout-v1.
sara: yes; we'll include both fields. mike, can billing process create the credit memos? tagging created_by=jen-revops.
mike: yep billing can create memos via API. need API change: POST /credit-memos with origin=legacy-exempt-sample. I’ll open a quick PR and assign.
billing-bot: invoice_sync_job failed for account 98765 at 1948502200 — retry queued. (automated)
rahul: that failure might affect sample assignment for that account. can we mark accounts with invoice_sync_issue and exclude from sample until resolution?
jen: exclude makes sense to avoid inconsistent state. add secondary check: exclude accounts with unpaid_balance > 90 days.
sara: ok action items: rahul - confirm cohort query and exclusion edgecases (due TOMORROW EOD). mike - PR for credit_memo API + runbook for manual memos (due in 48h). jen - add metric tags and reporting dashboard stub. i'll schedule a 30min sign-off meeting after PRs land. :thumbsup:
rahul: noted, will validate cohort and post any weird cases to this thread.
mike: will open PR in 2 hours and ping here.
jen: putting dashboard stub on revops board, will share link.
sara: thanks team. if no blockers by 48h we'll flip sample on at 10% between regions us/eu. keep thread for any follow-ups. :party:
